method: Daily Tmin: postprocess.extract at each cell centre of the 3 by 3 neighbourhood around every pin cell (met_daily, power-native-daily-utc-v1, UTC days). Read-only.
Hourly grid: hourly_archive.hourly_from_cache at the same cell centres (MERRA-2 hourly T2M from the cached archive, POWER Version 10.0.0). Local-night minimum and hours at or below 0, -1 and -2.2 C.
Cell elevation: one NASA POWER daily point request per cell (geometry elevation); the archive does not store elevation or land fraction. Land flag: cell centre inside the Natural Earth land mask.

Stations: NOAA GHCNh 2022 hourly files (QC codes other than blank, 0, 1, 4, 5, 9 dropped). Chilean station series were retrieved but are withheld from this file (see withheld_station_data in the Chile case).

Normal bias: station minus own-cell local-night minimum for every night of the event month in 2022, all nights and calm nights (median wind at or below 2 m/s). The protocol asks for 2010-2025; only 2022 was downloaded here.
Stage: production.analyse with the primary profile at each pin, through location_api.hourly_for and postprocess.extract (padding), the same inputs analyze() uses.
limits: Three events. Outcomes are categories, not an accuracy rate.
Station-minus-grid distributions use one month of 2022, not 2010-2025, so the normal-bias band is rough.
No cloud data were used; mechanism labels rest on wind and humidity.
MERRA-2 cell land fraction was not retrieved.
staging: Server work in tmp/EventChecksRegistry/ (script event_checks_v2.py, raw output event_checks_v2_raw.json). No archive, code, config or data folder was modified.

registration.crop_and_system: commercial blueberries, open field; species mix not stated in the IBO text
registration.corroborated_date_and_place: night of 30 to 31 October 2022, and 1 November in some zones; Coihueco most affected, then San Ignacio and El Carmen, Maule-Sur toward the cordillera

expected.station_hazard: yes, at least one station near Coihueco or Longavi at or below 0 C on the night ending 31 October
expected.grid_hazard_pin_cells: no; pin cells stay above 0 C (warm-biased 55 km cells, radiative frost)
expected.grid_hazard_neighbourhood: only in the Andean cells, which are not orchard land
expected.stage_agreement: yes for the Nuble pins (fruit); Maule pins may still be in late flowering

registration.honesty_note: The station minima for Coihueco and Linares 2 and the daily grid values were already published in the 2026-10-11 regional report and review. These expectations are therefore not blind. They were written before the v2 neighbourhood, local-night and station-minus-grid computations were run.

published_station_values.reading: The bulletin lists -2.2 C at Linares among the lowest values of the three October events; it does not say which day. The sentence begins "En noviembre de 2022", but it sits in the October analysis and mentions day 31, so October is meant.

outcome.station_hazard: yes: published values of -2.0 C at Coihueco (RAN station 107, 06:00 local on 31 October) and -2.2 C at Linares (DMC October 2022 bulletin, day not named)
outcome.grid_hazard_pin_cells: no: local-night minimum 4.56 C (Chillan and Coihueco cell) and 5.07 C (Linares and Longavi cell) on the night ending 31 October
outcome.grid_hazard_neighbourhood: yes only in the two Andean cells (1,428 m and 1,624 m): -0.74 C and -2.89 C on the night ending 31 October; these are not orchard cells
outcome.magnitude_diff_c: Coihueco published minimum minus its pin-cell local-night minimum on the event night: -6.56 C
outcome.normal_bias_comparison: withheld: needs the station series (see withheld_station_data)
outcome.timing_offset_days: grid cold one night early: the pin cells were coldest on the night ending 30 October (2.24 C and 3.69 C), the stations on the night ending 31 October
outcome.mechanism: radiative, as described in the trade reports; the station wind check is withheld
outcome.stage_agreement: yes at the Nuble pins (model: fruit, reported fruit set); adjacent at the Maule pins (model: last day of flowering on 1 November)

cases.verdict: The published station values confirm the frost on the night of 30 to 31 October 2022. Not represented in the pin cells, so the app would not flag it even with the right date. This is the expected behaviour of a daily 55 km grid on a radiative frost night, not a location or species error. Old case status: inconclusive because of the window.

withheld_station_data.reason: The RAN Agromet XML endpoint answered only with a browser user agent, and the INIA series came through the site data-request form. Both access routes are outside the project access rules without approval, so the station series and every value derived from them are withheld here.

stations.name: HAMILTON AWS
stations.licence: NOAA NCEI public data (US government work, no restrictions on use)

outcome.station_hazard: yes: Hamilton AWS -2.8 C hourly (-2.9 C NIWA absolute minimum), 7 hours at or below 0 C, 1 hour at or below -2.2 C
outcome.grid_hazard_pin_cells: no: the pin cell for Hamilton and Ohaupo (-38.0, 175.0) is coastal and reached 5.15 C
outcome.grid_hazard_neighbourhood: borderline in the inland cell (-38.0, 175.625): 0.06 C; yes in the cell to the south-east (-38.5, 175.625, 416 m): -0.94 C with 7 hours at or below 0 C
outcome.magnitude_diff_c: station minus pin cell -7.95; station minus the station's own (inland) cell -2.86
outcome.normal_bias_comparison: October 2022 calm-night station-minus-own-cell median -0.78 C, 10th percentile -3.04 C. The event-night gap against the own cell (-2.86) is at the edge of the normal calm-night range. Against the coastal pin cell it is far outside.
outcome.timing_offset_days: 0: the night ending 7 October was the coldest of the 7 nights in every land cell
outcome.mechanism: radiative after an advective outbreak: station wind median 1.5 m/s on the frost night against 3 to 5 m/s on the preceding nights
outcome.stage_agreement: yes (model flowering 27 September to 7 November; reported open flowers)

cases.verdict: Frost confirmed at the station on the morning of 7 October 2022. Missed because the nearest-cell rule picks a coastal cell; the inland neighbour reaches about 0 C, within the normal calm-night bias. A neighbourhood or land-weighted cell choice would bring the grid within about 3 C. Old case status: inconclusive because of the cell.

outcome.station_hazard: yes at all four: Alma -2.8, Homerville -1.6, Elizabethtown -4.5, Wilmington (31.9 km from Burgaw) -2.8 C
outcome.grid_hazard_neighbourhood: yes in every land cell of both neighbourhoods (-1.1 to -6.2 C); only the sea cell east of Burgaw stayed above 0 C
outcome.magnitude_diff_c: station minus own cell on the event night: +0.32, +0.93, +0.97 and +2.44 C (grid colder than stations)
outcome.normal_bias_comparison: Inside the March 2022 all-night range at every station (10th to 90th percentile about -2.7 to +3.1 C).
outcome.mechanism: advective: station wind medians 2.1 to 5.1 m/s on the freeze night; a calmer second night (14 March) followed, with Alma at -0.6 C

cases.verdict: Freeze confirmed at stations and represented in the grid on the right night. Consistent with the 2026-10-05 result. One weather episode, not four independent events.
